hooks.text: 把五十多种符文组合成自制法术卡，可同时加入伤害、减益、增益与召唤盟友等效果
hooks.excerpt: Combine over 50 Sigils - with effects that deal damage, inflict debuffs, grant buffs, summon allies, and more - to craft custom spell cards for your deck.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 面对敌方攻击时既可先摧毁攻击保护自己，也可选择硬吃伤害换取直接打击敌人的爆发机会
hooks.excerpt: Take on enemy attacks, destroying them to keep yourself safe from harm - or take the hit and attack enemies directly to do as much damage as possible.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 独立深渊模式随机分配角色和初始牌组，并将死亡改成彻底从头开启新一轮
hooks.excerpt: The Abyss is a separate mode with randomized characters and starting decks, where unlike the main game, dying means starting a new run from the very beginning.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
